name: @nasedkinpv/opensubdiv-wasm
description: WebAssembly port of OpenSubdiv for Three.js - High-performance Catmull-Clark subdivision surfaces in the browser

scripts.build:wasm: em++ -O3 -flto -std=c++17 -I./opensubdiv -I. src/wasm_bindings.cpp build-wasm/lib/libosdCPU.a -o dist/opensubdiv.js --bind -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='OpenSubdiv' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1
scripts.build:wasm:esm: em++ -O3 -flto -std=c++17 -I./opensubdiv -I. src/wasm_bindings.cpp build-wasm/lib/libosdCPU.a -o dist/opensubdiv.mjs --bind -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_NAME='OpenSubdiv' -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s ENVIRONMENT='web,worker'
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:esm && npm run build:wasm:optimize && npm run build:threejs
scripts.build:quick: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:esm && npm run build:threejs

author: nasedkinpv
